6116.title: Subscription exhaustion loses its error category
6116.rootCauseOneLine: Known subscription exhaustion is emitted as a generic Codex 429 with a roughly day-long Retry-After, without a distinct machine-readable exhaustion cause.
6116.proposedFix: Preserve the quota-exhaustion cause in the provider-facing response, validate the terminal consumer contract, and verify shared-queue release and readmission without changing transient pacing.
6116.caveats: The real plugin response was reproduced twice; live Codex reconnection and the complete cross-provider queue sequence were not exercised. The protocol-changing repair is outside the simple-fix gate. Reproduction patch and outputs are inline; raw artifacts remain local under reports repository policy.
